title: Ten years with Lee Collins's combo
summary: Williams says he worked mostly with trumpeter Lee Collins, piano and trumpet, from wartime until about 1950-51.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. With whom did you, uh, with whom else did you play here in Chicago? In which band or?
I didn't play no big band, I played combos. No, no, I mean combos, yeah. Oh, man. Lee Collins.
Lee Collins. Lee Collins. I played with Lee Collins 10 years, mostly with Lee Collins.

From when on? Huh? From when on? Well, about in wartime, when war was on, I was with Lee Collins. Up until fifty, fifty one. Oh, yeah. So long. Yeah. I was with Lee Collins. I was with Lee Collins. And what combo? Lee on trumpet, you on piano. Lee on trumpet, me on piano. And Jeep on trumpet, onto, on, on, on. We got, got a second. I had a second.
I heard about it. Jeep. I heard about it.
Jeep. What is it? What is it?
